cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-1
cards.audioText: What's your position? / Would you please introduce your work background?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的职位是什么？/ 能否介绍一下你的工作背景？
cards.referenceText:
I am a student pilot. I take flight training at Jiutian Flight School. I fly the DA - 40 for flight training. I have built up 100 flying hours. Now I only have my private pilot license.
我是一名飞行学员，在九天飞行学校接受飞行训练，驾驶 DA - 40 进行飞行训练，已积累 100 个飞行小时，目前仅持有私人飞行员执照 。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-2
cards.audioText: What type of aircraft are you flying now? / How many type ratings have you had?
cards.audioTextZh: 你目前驾驶的是哪种机型？/ 你已获得多少种机型等级资质？
cards.referenceText:
I am a student pilot. I take flight training at Jiutian Flight School. I fly the DA - 40 for flight training. I have built up 100 flying hours. Now I only hold my private pilot license.
我是一名飞行学员，在九天飞行学校接受飞行训练，驾驶 DA - 40 开展飞行训练，已积累 100 个飞行小时，目前仅持有私人飞行员执照 。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-3
cards.audioText: When/ Where did you take the transition training? What type of aircraft did you fly in The transition training? High performance training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你何时 / 何地进行的转机型训练？转机型训练中你驾驶的是哪种机型？高性能训练（相关情况）呢？
cards.referenceText:
I have not taken the transition training yet. Now I take flight training at Jiutian Flight School. I fly the DA - 40 for flight training. I have built up 100 flying hours. Now I only hold my private pilot license.
我尚未进行转机型训练。目前我在九天飞行学校接受飞行训练，驾驶 DA - 40 开展飞行训练，已积累 100 个飞行小时，现在仅持有私人飞行员执照 。
